review_candidates.title: Tööohutuse ja kriisikindluse juht
review_candidates.description: Tööohutuse ja kriisikindluse juht, tule panusta roheteekonda „Meie jaoks ei ole kriisikindlus ja tööohutus pelgalt nõuete täitmine, vaid meie tegevuse jätkusuutlikkuse eelduseks. Üha keerukamas ja muutlikumas keskkonnas peame suutma riske ennetada, olla valmis häireteks ning õppida juhtumitest kiiresti ja tulemuslikult. Seetõttu vajame tugevat juhti, kes looks tööohutuse ja kriisikindluse vahel tervikliku lähenemise ning aitaks selle mõtteviisi juurutada igapäevases juhtimises kõigis meie üksustes.“ Ivar Ruubel, Chief Operating Officer Sinu peamisteks tööülesanneteks on: juhtida tööohutuse ja toimepidevuse valdkonda strateegilisel tasandil; juhtida toimepidevuse ja kriisijuhtimise tegevusi, sealhulgas õppuseid ning intsidentidele reageerimist; juhtida tulemusnäitajaid, aruandlust ja pideva parendamise tegevusi; tagada vastavus õigusaktidele ning ISO 45001 nõuetele; tagada kriitiliste varade toimepidevuse nõuete rakendamine ja valmisolek kriisiolukordadeks; arendada ohutuskultuuri, protsesse ja juhtimissüsteeme; teha koostööd juhtide, töötajate ja partneritega, et luua ohutu ja vastupidav töökeskkond. Meiega on sul võimalus : kujundada ligi 600 töötaja töökeskkonda Eestis ja Baltikumis; olla juhtkonna strateegiline partner; tegutseda mitmekesises keskkonnas, mis hõlmab energeetikat, tootmist, hooldust ja kõrge riskiga töid; vedada eest kultuuri arengut ning ellu viia uusi lahendusi; 5 lisapuhkuse päeva peale esimest tööaastat; liituda endale meelepärase heaolupaketiga, mis sisaldab tervisekindlustust ja/või Stebby teenuseid. Ootame just sind, kui sul on: vähemalt 5-aastane kogemus tööohutuse valdkonna juhtimisel ja arendamisel; valmisolek külastada Enefiti üksuseid Baltikumis; kogemus toimepidevuse tagamisega, auditite ja juhtumite uurimisega; teadmised juurpõhjuste analüüsi metoodikatest ning oskus kasutada andmepõhiseid tööriistu; süsteemne ja analüütiline mõtteviis ning soov protsesse järjepidevalt paremaks muuta; oskus mõjutada ja kaasata erinevaid osapooli ühiste eesmärkide saavutamisel; väga hea eesti ja inglise keele oskus, vene keel tuleb kasuks. Lisainfo Asukoht: Tallinn, osaline kaugtöö võimalus juhiga kokkuleppel. Ootame sinu CV-d hiljemalt 13.09.2026. Sinu küsimustele värbamisprotsessi kohta vastab personalipartner Kaiti Järvela (Kaiti.Järvela@Enefit.com).

review_candidates.description: Paymentwall is a leading global payments platform that helps businesses accept payments from over 150 local payment methods—including credit and debit cards, bank transfers, e-wallets, prepaid cards, and mobile carrier billing—through a single, seamless integration. With a presence across multiple continents, we make it easy for businesses to expand globally by simplifying cross-border payments and creating localized payment experiences for millions of users worldwide. Who Are We Looking For We’re looking for a proactive and meticulous Treasury Specialist who excels in dynamic, cross-border environments and is motivated by the challenge of managing liquidity, streamlining fund flows, and fostering strong banking relationships. You should be analytical, well-structured, and process-oriented—dedicated to precise reporting, effective FX management, and ongoing enhancement of treasury operations and internal procedures. Honesty and Trust are core to who we are. We expect transparent and truthful communication from all our team members. Learning and Curiosity are essential for growth here. You bring fresh ideas, creativity, and a desire to develop daily, absorbing knowledge from those around you. Multilingual and Multicultural We operate across borders and value team members who can bridge cultural and legal diﬀerences with ease. Position Overview This role will be responsible for reviewing invoices and payment documentation, coordinating with international banks, monitoring payment status, and ensuring transactions are processed accurately and efficiently. The position will also contribute to budgeting, financial reporting, reconciliations, and understanding the company’s overall cash and payment flows. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, international payments environment. What You Will Do Review invoices and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, validity, and completeness before releasing payments. Work with international banks on banking-related matters, including opening and maintaining corporate bank accounts, tracking payment status, and resolving payment-related inquiries. Support administrative and documentation requirements requested by banks. Develop a strong understanding of the company's cash and payment flows. Assist with treasury and accounting activities as needed. Support budgeting, financial reporting, and other finance-related processes. Skills & Competencies Required Strong understanding of accounting principles, treasury operations, cash management, payment processing, and financial controls. Experience working with banks on payments, account management, payment tracking, and banking documentation. Strong ability to reconcile bank accounts, payment records, and accounting data accurately. High level of accuracy when reviewing invoices, payment instructions, financial records, and supporting documentation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies and resolve payment or banking issues. Ability to manage multiple payment requests, deadlines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working with international banks, multiple currencies, cross-border transactions, and global teams. Who Should Apply Must have a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; 3+ years experience in Accounting; Experience with budgeting and financial reporting; Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; Highly organized, with a focus on attention to detail; Strong organization and problem-solving skills; Excellent verbal and written communication skills; Intermediate - Upper Intermediate level of English (written & spoken). Why Join Us? If you are eager to take your career to the next level in the payment industry, this is the opportunity for you. We offer: Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills. Individual career path and growth opportunities. Work with an international team and gain in-depth knowledge about payments in different markets. Exposure to the fintech and gaming industries. Paid vacation Office-based role in Kuala Lumpur Office at Menara Allianz Sentral — surrounded by like-minded innovators. This role is the ideal opportunity for someone looking for new challenges that would allow them to make a noticeable, positive impact in the company while learning and adapting to our fast-paced scale-up environment. As part of our pioneering team in Kuala Lumpur, you will have a lot of opportunities to develop your career further with us. With future expansion plans, now is a great time to join us on our journey to change the way we pay. Notes: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description After an initial training period, you will be responsible for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance of our injection molding systems at our customers' facilities. You will operate from your home office ideally located in Warsaw, Katowice or Krakow area with general administrative support from our European headquarters in Luxembourg. This position offers great challenges and has a direct impact on the final business result and growth opportunities. It is a unique opportunity to join a very dynamic organization, combining your technology focus and inter-human skills to support our global customer base. Responsibilities Traveling regularly to our customers (area covering Poland 60% of time and Central Europe (40%). Central Europe extends to Greece, you will be responsible for troubleshooting issues, installing or upgrading all Husky products. You will help our customers optimize their operations with on-site training and follow-up visits. You will be responsible for the execution and follow-up of your customer visits, creating reports and offering advice to promote Husky’s products and services. You should be a self-started that understands the importance of customer satisfaction and can be an ambassador for our strong core values. Qualifications Technician or engineering degree - mechatronics or electronics. General experience in control systems, and/or equivalent hydraulic, electrical or mechanical experience. Troubleshooting attitude and focus on correct working practices. Knowledge in PLC controls and in industrial automated systems. The post holder works closely with Programme Operations, Finance, Legal, Awards, and field teams to ensure procurement solutions are responsive to operational and programme needs and contribute to effective delivery for children. In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly. Key Areas Of Accountability Procurement Planning and Service Delivery Coordinate annual and project procurement planning with budget holders and relevant functions, consolidating demand and identifying appropriate sourcing strategies and timelines. Ensure procurement requests are complete, properly approved and translated into timely procurement actions that meet programme and operational requirements. Monitor sourcing pipelines, lead times and delivery status, and proactively address bottlenecks and tracking procurement KPIs, including purchasing efficiency and on-time delivery . Sourcing, Tendering, and Contracting Lead and coordinate sourcing processes for goods, works, and services in accordance with applicable procurement thresholds, policies, and donor requirements. Prepare or review solicitation documents, competitive bid analysis, evaluation records, approvals, purchase orders, and contracts to ensure completeness, fairness, and auditability. Facilitate evaluation processes and negotiations that achieve best value, appropriate quality, acceptable risk, and required delivery timelines. Compliance, Risk, and Safeguarding Ensure procurement activities comply with Save the Children policies, scheme of delegation, donor rules, anti-fraud and anti-corruption requirements, conflicts-of-interest controls, and applicable Indonesian law. Maintain complete and accurate procurement files and an effective audit trail, and support internal reviews, external audits, and compliance spot checks. Integrate child safeguarding, safe programming, data protection, environmental considerations, and responsible procurement requirements into supplier selection and contract management. Supplier, Framework Agreement, and Contract Management Coordinate supplier due diligence, registration, performance monitoring, and periodic review, including required compliance and safeguarding screening. Lead the establishment, renewal, and performance monitoring of Framework Agreements (FWAs) to improve procurement efficiency and supplier availability. Build and maintain an appropriate, competitive, and diverse supplier base, including local suppliers where suitable. Support contract owners in monitoring supplier performance, deliverables, service levels, pricing, variations, disputes, and contract close-out, Systems, Data, Analytics, and Performance Ensure procurement transactions and master data are accurately recorded in Oracle NetSuite and other approved systems and trackers. Produce procurement reports and analytical insights on procurement plans, sourcing cycle time, spend patterns, supplier performance, savings, compliance, purchasing efficiency, and on-time delivery . Identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to support management decisions. Promote data quality, standardisation of item and supplier information, and practical process improvements that strengthen efficiency and user experience. Business Partnering, Team Coordination, and Humanitarian Response Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders to improve procurement planning, policy compliance, service delivery, and internal customer satisfaction. Provide practical procurement guidance to requesters, budget holders, field offices, and partners, and contribute to training and capacity strengthening. Coordinate workload and provide day-to-day technical support, quality review, and coaching to procurement officers. Collaborate with Finance, Awards, Legal, Programme Operations, Safety & Security, Tech & Digital, and Logistics to resolve procurement issues and support integrated delivery. Support rapid procurement and supplier mobilisation during emergency preparedness and response while maintaining proportionate controls and documentation. Ensure that suppliers and contractors who may interact with children or communities understand and comply with applicable safeguarding obligations. Promote a safe, respectful, inclusive, and accountable working environment. Essential EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS: Relevant professional experience in procurement, sourcing, contracting, or supply chain, including experience coordinating competitive tenders for goods, works, and services. Experience applying procurement policies, delegated authorities, donor or institutional compliance requirements, and maintaining audit-ready documentation. Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and respond to changing operational needs. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, including the ability to review commercial offers, identify risks, and present clear recommendations. Effective communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to provide advice and challenge non-compliant requests constructively. High level of integrity and ability to manage confidential and commercially sensitive information. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and experience using an ERP or e-procurement system. Professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Commitment to Save the Children values, safeguarding principles, diversity, equity, and inclusion. Desirable Experience in an international NGO, humanitarian organisation, development agency, or other donor-funded environments. Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable procurement/ERP platform. Experience supervising, coaching, or technically coordinating procurement staff or focal points. review_candidates.title: Operator-HP
review_candidates.description: Job Description In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Assembly , testing, and packaging production of mechanical products Regular equipment inspection On-site 5S implemention Completion of various production support document Other tasks assigned by the supervisor Who You Are: You engage key stakeholders early and consider the upside and downside scenarios. You think about multiple ways to get the same outcome. You seize on common points of agreement. You act with a clear sense of ownership. You bounce back from setbacks. For This Role, You Will Need: Junior high school education and above, with basic English and computer skills. At least 2 years of experience in an electronics company or mechanical industry Detail-oriened, strong quality awareness, steady and with good learning and comprehension ablities. Meet the environmental of the company position Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that phenomenal ideas come from great teams. Our dedication to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. About Us WHY EMERSON Our Commitment to Our People At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together. Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com . About Emerson Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go! No calls or agencies please.
